Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 5
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted “established” in the context of “original eight charter franchises,” shifting the answer from 1901 (the American League’s establishment as a major league and the year the charter franchises are defined) to 1900 (the Western League’s renaming). This conflated organizational renaming with the league’s major-league establishment, leading to the wrong year.
